speaker: Samantha
text: In addition, our move from conversation means diminished opportunities to learn skills of self-reflection. These days, social media continually asks us what's “on our mind”, but we have little motivation to say something truly self-reflective. Imagine how hard it is to do something with thousands of online friends! It is through the conversation with trusted others that we learn to converse with ourselves - to be honest with ourselves.
